desc: Derive algorithm: order-preserving adjacent swaps reduce to 1D median of a_i = p_i - i; answer is sum of absolute deviations from median.
Write the complete Python program: parse N and S from stdin, collect positions of '1', compute a_i = pos[i] - i, take median m = a[k//2], print sum(abs(a_i - m)).
Verify edge cases: already contiguous ones, single one, all ones, ones at string ends; confirm samples give 3, 0, 7.
Review complexity (O(N) time, O(k) memory) and finalize code enclosed in delimiters.
